nodes.title: CLmax 0.9 of the reflexed wing (SUPERSEDED)
nodes.text: The MH 45-type reflexed section with elevons neutral reaches CLmax = 0.9 at Re ~3e5
nodes.basis: config-study card ESTIMATE. SUPERSEDED 2026-11-09 by B2's trimmed CLmax 0.80 (CL-B2-CLMAX-DESIGN, S5010, SM 5 %), which CALC-A1-STALL now reads; the node stays only until B1, B3 and C1 re-point their inputs (CHANGE-LOG D-02)

nodes.title: Box wall stack 12.5 mm per side along the chord
nodes.text: The transport box loses 12.5 mm per side along the chord: 4 mm corrugated shell at both ends plus the 1/2 in PE nose pad (D7-R4 stack after D-62: 4 + 4 + 12.7 = 20.7 mm over two sides); the span and height faces lose 4 mm plus the cradle and pillar preloads, less than this
nodes.basis: D7 CL-D7-NOSE-GAP (12.95 mm at the 0.498 m envelope with a 3/4 in pad); D-62 moves the nose 10 mm and the pad goes to 1/2 in (CR-A1-66). Was 25 mm (R0 guess: 1/4 in ply + 18 mm foam)

nodes.title: Pack station A3's current roll-up carries
nodes.text: The pack centroid x at which A3's published CL-A3-CG-X and CL-A3-MASS-BASIC were rolled up
nodes.basis: A3-R6a (2026-11-10) rolled the carried pack at the D-47 datum -0.022 m. D-62 moves the datum to -0.032 m; until A3 re-runs on D2's R6 bay this assumption recovers the empty-aircraft moment from A3's numbers. Set it equal to pod.pack_x_nominal_m (and retire it) once A3 has re-run

nodes.title: Aircraft CG shift from D-61 not yet in A3's roll-up
nodes.text: D-61 moves the four motor stacks (motor, adapter, prop, nut; about 108 g each) 5 mm forward (face_ahead_m 0.0025 -> 0.0075): about -0.9 mm on the take-off CG
nodes.basis: E1 CR-E1-44 estimate (4 x 108 g x 5 mm / 2 322 g = 0.93 mm). Set to 0 once A3 re-runs on E1's D-61 centroids

nodes.title: Pack masses the frame checks (D-64)
nodes.text: Lightest and heaviest flight pack the CG and gate checks run with: the Ovonic 120C EC5 listing minus its tolerance (546 g) and the acceptance line A1 set in D-64 (590 g; CALC-A1-PACK-ACCEPT gives the exact figure from A3's gate margin)
nodes.basis: E2 CR-E2-24: listing 551 +/- 5 g. D-64 retires the 503 / 680 g bounding listings of D-58/D-59 as flight cases; A3 updates ASM-A3-PACK-RANGE to the same pair

nodes.title: Flying mass added by the R5 decisions, not yet in A3's roll-up
nodes.text: C3's pod fixes +13.9 g EST (CR-C3-14/-15/-16), D-62 nose shell +2 g, C6 pins 2.5 mm +1.5 g and collar 13 mm +0.6 g, D3's sealing bead -1.6 g, C5's shoe sleeve fix +5 g EST (CR-C5-18): +21.4 g
nodes.basis: D-63; set to 0 once D2, D3 and D5 publish and A3 re-runs

nodes.title: Wing area and aspect ratio
nodes.equation: S = b c ; AR = b^2 / S

nodes.title: Elevon area fraction
nodes.equation: A = 2 (span_in + span_out) f c ; frac = A / S

nodes.title: Prop clearances
nodes.equation: gap_vert = 2 z_m - D ; gap_lat = 2 y_m - D ; gap_tip = b/2 - y_m - D/2 ; gap_tube = (x_mount - r_tube) - x_prop ; gap_wing = z_m - D/2 - t_c c / 2 ; min of the five

nodes.title: Stance tip-over angles toward the pod side (narrow axis) and the wing tip
nodes.equation: h = c - x_cg + foot ; narrow = atan((z_pad - z_cg) / h) ; wide = atan(y_fin / h) ; corner bound at x_cg = x_range[0], z_cg = z_range[1]; target at x_target, z_cg = z_target_a3

nodes.title: Box fit
nodes.equation: internal = external - 2 wall ; slack = internal - envelope (sorted largest first)

nodes.title: params cg range sits inside B3's V1 claims (CG height included) and holds the target
nodes.equation: fwd_ok = x_range[0] - x_fwd ; aft_ok = x_aft - x_range[1] ; width = x_range[1] - x_range[0] ; target_fwd = x_t - x_range[0] ; target_aft = x_range[1] - x_t ; sm_aft = (x_np - x_range[1]) / c - sm_min

nodes.title: CG per weighed pack at its D-60 flight station in the D-62 bay
nodes.equation: x_cg = CL-A3-CG-X * c + dx_stack ; dx = CL-A3-CG-X-PRED - CL-A3-CG-X * c ; M_e x_e = M x_cg - m_p x_a3 (A3 rolls the carried pack at x_a3) ; x_fwd = x_pod_le + nose + L/2 ; x_aft = x_nom + aft_travel ; g(m) = dx M / (M_e + m) ; x_p(m) = x_aft - k step, k >= 0 the whole step that puts the mid of basic and predicted CG, x_cg(m) + g(m)/2, nearest x_t, x_p >= x_fwd ; x_cg(m) = (M_e x_e + m x_p) / (M_e + m) ; x_pred = x_cg + g(m) ; fwd margin = min x_cg - x_range[0] ; aft margin = x_range[1] - max x_pred ; ballast(nose) = (M_e + m) excess / (x_pred - x_pod_le)

nodes.title: Heaviest flight pack the first-build overrun still covers (D-64 acceptance line)
nodes.equation: accept = m_pack + gate_margin - overrun - added ; margin_sku = accept - (sku_min + 10)

nodes.title: Sized mass and A1 reserve from the allocations
nodes.equation: alloc = sum(allocations) ; sized = alloc + growth_allowance + build_overrun ; reserve_cover = growth_reserve - (growth_allowance + build_overrun) ; gate_check = gate - alloc - growth_reserve

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the gate and sized mass
nodes.equation: T/W = n T_max / m ; sag case x voltage_sag ; DL = m g / (n pi D^2/4)

nodes.title: Stall and transition speed at the gate
nodes.equation: Vs = sqrt(2 m g / (rho S CLmax_trimmed)) ; Vt = k Vs

nodes.title: Budget reserve, pessimistic
Wing reference area
nodes.how: Measure the hot-wired core: span x chord.

nodes.title: Aspect ratio
nodes.how: Follows from the measured span and chord.

nodes.title: Elevon area fraction
nodes.how: Measure the cut elevon panels; B3 confirms authority with AVL and the foam-board twin (upper bound 0.25 is checked by B3).

nodes.title: Minimum prop clearance (frame bound: disc edge to the wing plane)
nodes.how: check.py hull keep-out test (A5) on D3's R5 mount, then a 25 mm printed gauge on the built aircraft between the blade tip and the tube (T-B4-INSTALLED).
nodes.note: D-61: this frame bound (uncanted disc, hub mid-plane) is not the governing clearance. The claims of record are E1's CL-E1-TIP-GAP-TUBE / B4's CL-B4-GAP-TUBE-ENV (blade swept volume to the CF motor tube at the 7 deg cant: 21.1 mm at face_ahead 2.5 mm, 26.1 mm at the D-61 7.5 mm, CL-E1-TIP-GAP-AT-75) and B4's CL-B4-TIP-WING (34.2 mm to the upper skin).

nodes.title: Tip-over angle toward the pod side, worst flying CG corner (forward limit, top of cg.z_range_m)
nodes.how: Stand the aircraft on a tilting board with the pack at the forward limit (C5 T-C5-TIPOVER / H1 GT-10): record the angle at which it tips toward the pod.
nodes.note: D-30: frame-level corner bound with D5's pad contact z (CL-D5-CONTACT-Z); C5's CL-C5-TIPOVER-WORST (32.4 deg) is the claim of record.

nodes.title: Tip-over angle toward the pod side at the CG target, z_cg 0
nodes.how: As CL-A1-TIPOVER with the pack at the target station; compare with C5's CL-C5-TIPOVER-R1 (32.8 deg, z_cg 0.017).

nodes.title: Aircraft fits the box
nodes.how: Place the props-off aircraft in the built box on its cradles; lid closes without touching fins or tubes (D7).

nodes.title: Sized take-off mass (allocations + planned growth + overrun)
nodes.how: A3 roll-up of every parts.csv against MASS-CG.md (CL-A3-MASS-PREDICTED is the maturity-based prediction); weigh the built aircraft with pack (H1).

nodes.title: A1 mass reserve covers the planned growth and overrun
nodes.how: growth_reserve_g in params.json minus (growth allowance + 100 g build overrun; D-63: 114 + 100 = 214 g, 0 g free); A3's maturity growth (CL-A3-GATE-MARGIN) is the stricter check.

nodes.title: Allocations plus reserve equal the gate
nodes.how: 2 600 - sum(allocation_g) - growth_reserve_g must be >= 0; A1 re-runs this script after any allocation change.

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the 2.6 kg gate
nodes.how: Thrust stand, one station, 11x5.5MR on a fresh pack with the 100 A limiter (24.8 A per motor): thrust >= 1.3 kgf gives T/W 2.0 at 2.6 kg (H1, T-E1-STAND).

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the gate, worst pack state
nodes.how: Thrust-stand run on a pack at 3.6 V/cell after a cold soak at 10 degC (H1 GT-02, pass line CL-H1-T-PASS-SAG >= 1.102 kgf), or the fresh value x CL-E1-SAG-FACTOR (CL-E1-TW-WORST).
nodes.note: D-49: voltage_sag 0.851 is the one E1/E2 calculation (CALC-E1-WORST on E2's cell data and F1's r_ext 6.5 mOhm, CL-E1-SAG-FACTOR; CL-E1-TW-WORST 2.12); was 0.76 (D-35).

nodes.title: Stall speed at the gate
nodes.how: Trimmed CLmax from B2 (CL-B2-CLMAX-DESIGN); flight test: slow-flight stall in FBWA at altitude with airspeed logged (H2, T-B2-STALL).

nodes.title: Transition speed at the gate
nodes.how: Cruise 16 m/s (B1) against 1.3 x the trimmed stall; log airspeed at 'Transition FW done' (F4/H2). Closed by D-01: chord 0.32 and cruise 16 m/s.

nodes.title: Pessimistic reserve at order
nodes.how: I1 re-prices the BOM at order time; reserve = 2 000 - spend, pessimistic column.

nodes.title: params cg.x_range_m forward end is inside B3's V1 forward limit (trim at the stall, CG height included)
nodes.how: Re-run after any B3 publish; the built aircraft is balanced at both marks (T-A3-CG-BALANCE, H1 GT-07).
nodes.note: D-62 (CR-B3-25): params carry B3's V1 range rounded inward to 0.1 mm, [0.0466, 0.0514]; the take-off CG 18.5 mm above the chord plane moves the effective NP 3.4 mm forward at 1.3 Vs, so the whole range slides 4.3 mm forward at the same width (4.8 mm). Was [0.0509, 0.0548] (D-60, B3 R4 at z = 0), [0.050, 0.0549] (D-47).

nodes.title: params cg.x_range_m aft end is inside B3's V1 aft limit (SM 5 % at 1.3 Vs, CG height included)
nodes.how: As CL-A1-CG-RANGE-FWD; static margin at the aft mark from the twin's glide tests (T-B3-TWIN-NP).

nodes.title: Width of the CG range between the balance marks
nodes.how: Distance between the two marks on the fin roots.
nodes.note: B3's CL-B3-V-CG-WIDTH-ENV 4.85 mm on the unrounded limits; the full D6 free-play band (not half) would take it to 3.3 mm (CR-B3-23: D6 centres each servo in its band).

nodes.title: CG target sits inside the range with the smaller of its two margins
nodes.how: Balance the built aircraft with the carried pack at its flight-card station: the CG mark falls between the two limit marks.
nodes.note: D-62: target 0.0490 = range mid (2.4 mm to each mark); replaces CL-A1-CG-CENTRED (B3's R3 pack-centred CG, retired with CL-B3-CG-CENTRED-AFT).

nodes.title: Lightest pack at its D-60 station: forward travel left to the crush stack
nodes.how: D2 re-lays the bay (CR-A1-62); T-A3-CG-BALANCE with each pack at its flight-card station.
nodes.note: D-62 bay: most forward centroid = pod.x_le_m (-0.140) + 34.6 mm + L/2 = -0.0379 m for the 135 mm Ovonic EC5 pack (D-64); the no-spacer station is -0.020 (aft stop 0.050). A1-R4a (D-59) had -0.0254 / -0.010 in the D-47 bay.

nodes.title: Every pack (546 / 550 / 590 g, D-64) at its D-60 station: basic CG margin to the forward limit
nodes.how: T-A3-CG-BALANCE / H1 GT-07 with each weighed pack at its flight-card station.
nodes.note: Worst case is the heaviest pack at the no-spacer station (nominal + pod.pack_aft_travel_m 12 mm, D-59/D-60); growth moves the CG aft, so basic is the forward-limit case. D-62 estimate on A3-R6a with ASM-A1-A3-PACK-X and ASM-A1-STACK-DX; A3 re-runs on D2's R6 bay.

nodes.title: Every pack at its D-60 station: predicted CG (growth by maturity) margin to the aft limit
nodes.how: T-A3-CG-BALANCE on the built aircraft; never fly aft of the aft mark (B3).
nodes.note: D-62: worst case is the lightest pack (546 g) at or near the crush stack; growth is A3's CL-A3-CG-X-PRED scaled by mass. The 503 g listing is no longer a flight case (D-64).

nodes.title: Nose ballast the predicted CG needs with the worst pack (D-59 cap 10 g, D-60 rule)
nodes.how: Balance the built aircraft; add lead tape behind the nose block until the CG is 0.5 mm ahead of the aft mark; weigh it.
nodes.note: About 13 g per mm of CG at the pod nose, from the A1 reserve; beyond 10 g A1 re-opens the station.

nodes.title: Heaviest flight pack the 100 g first-build overrun still covers (D-64 acceptance line)
nodes.how: Weigh each pack on arrival (T-E2-WEIGH, 1 g scale); a pack above this line is returned or the first build must come in under its allocations.
nodes.note: D-64: replaces the D-58/D-59 lines (601 -> 631 g on the old bounding listings). The Ovonic 120C EC5 lists 551 +/- 5 g, so the limit here is its maximum 556 g; E2's PACK_ACCEPT_KG and the T-E2-WEIGH pass line follow this claim. A3 publishes the same figure from its roll-up (CL-A3-GATE-MARGIN) once D2, D3 and D5 deliver the R5 parts.

nodes.title: Weigh the assembled aircraft
nodes.procedure: Pack in, props on, 5 kg scale with 1 g resolution; record with the pack's own mass (H1).

nodes.title: Thrust stand, one station
nodes.procedure: X3108S + 11x5.5MR on the 20 kg load cell (A/B with the 11x4.5MR), fresh pack then a 20 % pack at 10 degC, 0-100 % in 10 % steps, log gf, A, V and rpm (T-E1-STAND, T-B4-STAND).
